frozen_basis.comparison_rule: Identical demand path, opening stock, PO reserves and exogenous conditions for every package.

objective: Pareto tradeoffs: continuity gap, shortage, known conditional costs, unallocated service hours, review planned. No hidden scalar weighting; human chooses.
limitations: Bounded six-case episode, not all 40 cases or a globally optimal policy.
SC01 and SC02 share one stock trajectory and shipment; SC17 and SC18 share one invoice-review decision.
No trained RL, causal company savings, validated stockout probability, completed task, accepted receipt, payment or physical execution is claimed.
Receiving energy exposure is shown explicitly; without an operational conversion rule it does not invent downtime, demand loss or automatic receipt delay.
Transport and role reservations use the existing conservative review-day capacity rules, not a detailed vehicle-routing or shift schedule.
